title: A complete language in log space collapses the classes
statement: Let $C$ be a language over the Boolean alphabet. If $C$ belongs to $\mathrm{NL}$ and every language in $\mathrm{NL}$ is log-space reducible to $C$, and if $C$ belongs to deterministic logarithmic space, then $\mathrm{NL}=\mathrm{LOGSPACE}$.
hypotheses_covered: Every language in NL is log-space reducible to C
